scientific_question: On the accepted PRO6 reproduction, does bilateral full-carry c_proj endpoint transport reduce exact fixed-window complete-model CE relative to the right-only endpoint?

derivation.change_from_parent: Only the internally paired checkpoint/snapshot identity and host paths change from Y400 to its accepted PRO6 replay. Variants, exact evaluation protocol, thresholds, and selection order are unchanged.

registered_decision_rule.candidate_pass: All values must be finite; candidate validation CE must be at least 0.002 below hidden88_full_carry; candidate train CE must be no worse; and candidate validation distance from dense endpoint must be smaller than right-only.
registered_decision_rule.authorization_on_pass: A pass authorizes only production implementation of the smallest passing no-learned-basis bilateral optimizer path, exact update/resume tests, and a separately preregistered directly polled >=20 percent MFU preflight. It does not authorize language-model training.
registered_decision_rule.authorization_on_failure: Do not implement bilateral output rotation; move to a preregistered bounded non-orthogonal residual diagnostic.

limitations: Only the five recorded layers are replaced.
Directions are teacher-forced from the paired dense replay.
This is a 0.5 TPP endpoint capacity/task-direction oracle, not causal candidate training.
